svg.title: TransportContext -- Shared Netty Server, ClientFactory & Zero-Copy
svg.desc: Shared common/network-common Netty framing, SASL/AES bootstraps, connection pooling, and FileRegion ChunkFetch. 1. NettyRpcEnv to Driver Transport: new TransportContext(:41000) (driver-1 in-JVM); 2. BlockTransferSvc to TransportContext: new TransportContext(:42001) (worker-a in-JVM); 3. ExecutorBackend to Exec RPC Transport: createClient(driver-1:41000) (worker-a in-JVM); 4. Exec RPC Transport to Driver Transport: RpcRequest (control frame) (driver-1:41000); 5. TransportContext to BlockManager: getChunk() FileRegion (worker-a in-JVM); 6. Driver Transport to NettyRpcEnv: NettyRpcHandler.receive() (driver-1 in-JVM)
